description: Use this when no tool covers the data you need (e.g. air quality, crypto OHLC, flight prices): records one demand signal (data_type, description, example_query, max_price_sats) so BitTuitive can add or source it. Free; creates no account and charges nothing. Side effect: stores your request for the operator (rate-limited per client). Example: request_data(data_type="weather", description="hourly air quality index by ZIP", max_price_sats=20)

contact.description: Optional email for an operator follow-up. Never published.

data_type.description: Category, e.g. weather, stocks, traffic, other.

example_query.description: An example query or URL shape you would send.

max_price_sats.description: The most you would pay per call, in sats.

name: request_data
title: Request data BitTuitive does not have (free)
